calculation.description: Fade the completed session's close-to-open move, normalized by the prior 20-session average true range. Values are computed using data available at the close of t and are used for next-session forward returns; no future inputs are used.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in every calendar year 2020-2026: 0.02876, 0.04518, 0.05315, 0.03766, 0.04384, 0.04367, and 0.03904 respectively. Cross-section is the available 15-asset benchmark universe; each observation requires at least 8 valid instruments.
